description: List MergeSafe's findings on the latest review of a pull request. Each has severity (P0 most severe .. P3), title, problem, file, line, status, blocking and comment_url, the inline comment on GitHub that holds the full explanation and a prompt for fixing it. Loop: for each blocking finding, check the claim against the file as it stands now; if it holds, fix it and add a regression test; run the tests; commit and push; then call request_review. A finding of type question (needs_decision) asks whether a behavior is intended, with its severity_if_unintended; it does not block. It needs a decision, not just a fix, and it is likely a human one. Not intended: fix it (the fix answers it). Intended: say so on its thread; evidence helps (the PR's ticket, the PR description, a test, a doc or a file:line). Unsure: leave it open, or ask whoever owns the change.
name: get_findings
title: Get pull request findings
